name: hammond
description: History, catalog and findings of your Home Assistant, from your HAmmond server in the LAN.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to a HAmmond server on your local network. Issue a personal token in the HAmmond admin GUI (Tokens) and enter it here. Read-only: HAmmond never changes anything in Home Assistant.

url.title: HAmmond address
url.description: MCP endpoint of your HAmmond server, e.g. https://hammond.lan/mcp

token.title: Personal token
token.description: Token from the HAmmond admin GUI (Tokens), starts with hmd_

ca_file.title: Certificate of the server (optional)
ca_file.description: hammond-ca.crt from https://<server>/hammond-ca.crt when the server uses its own local certificate

allow_http.title: Allow unencrypted http://
allow_http.description: Only for a server on a trusted network without HTTPS
